name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted platform for uploading, sharing, embedding and live streaming terminal session recordings made with the asciinema CLI.

alerts.message: Login is passwordless via an emailed link. Without SMTP configured (add SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USERNAME and SMTP_PASSWORD to the asciinema service), the link is printed to the asciinema service logs on a line containing "url from email". The first account to sign up becomes the admin; set SIGN_UP_DISABLED to true afterwards to close registration.
